items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Did you ever hear Buddy Petit or Chris Kelly or any of those bands? ... I heard them. But I didn't know too much about music.

ctx.x: Well they don't swim in it. Do they drink? You mean I don't drink. Yeah you don't drink. When I'm there all I'm drinking is lemon and water. You keep the pipes free. Because I'm watching them hours. I ain't worried about, I get all the liquor I want. I ain't worried about that. You understand? And we have to do they drink. You can't buy what they drink. As much as they drink, sure they drink. We've got butlers and waiters. I played with a band back in metric from eight to twelve. And they hired me to play the…
Yeah, I was wondering about Peter Williams, who he played with.
